subject: Re: CuBERT kickoff - resourcing
body:
Priya,

Plan of record:

- Gustavo Moreau is committed at 70% to cubert for May 2026 - he is running the deduplication rebuild and the first fine-tuning sweep, both of which have to happen in May or the June milestone is dead. He tapers to 40% from June.
- Katya Silva 45% across the window, label pipeline from review outcomes.
- Oyin Iversen 40%, corpus extraction from the monorepo.
- Halima Toure 20% from June, evaluation.

Compute: fine-tuning the released large checkpoint is cheap - about 300 GPU-hours. Pre-training our own is not. Ines has us down for 128 GPUs on vulcan-h100 for the last two weeks of June, and I've told her we can work around the 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-24 maintenance window by starting the run on the 25th.

Gustavo's May allocation is the thing I'd defend hardest if anything comes up.

Alina
